Story
Ghost Knight: A Dark Tale is an atmospheric action platformer that immerses you in a vividly colorful haunting world, where a deranged king, obsessed with immortality, rips open portals to a nightmarish dimension. Fight your way through undead, creatures, and beasts to stop the king's mad quest.

Features:
●Spectral Hero:
Play as Ghost Knight, a spirit bound to a suit of armor, and harness otherworldly powers to navigate a perilous world.
●A Haunting World:
Immerse yourself in a toon-style dark fantasy world, featuring atmospheric visuals.
●Enhanced Retro-Feel:
Timeless side-scrolling gameplay enhanced with contemporary 3D art.
●Epic Action and Platforming:
Jump, Double-Jump, and Dash through tight platforming sections.
●Enemy Variety:
Fight your way through diverse enemies (So far 30 Enemy Types with different behaviors)
●Tough Boss Fights:
Test your skills against difficult bosses and absorb their souls to trade and upgrade your skills and armor.
